setup: A second partial derivative differentiates a first partial once more: for \(f(x,y) = [[f]]\), find \([[second_name]]\) by differentiating \([[first_name]]\).

steps.say: First partial: \([[first_name]] = [[first]]\), differentiating with the other variable held fixed.
Differentiate again, in the variable the second subscript names: \([[second_name]] = [[second]]\).
